description: Akteursgruppen FTTH is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Land Schleswig-Holstein. Der Datensatz enthält die Gebietskulisse der in Schleswig-Holstein aktiven Akteursgruppen. Diese gliedern sich in: - Breitbandzweckverbände - Stadtwerke - Amts- und Gemeindeinitiativen - Privatwirtschaft Die Geometrien basieren auf ALKIS und wurden auf Grundlage der Gemeindebene aggregiert. Spaltenbeschreibung: - ID - Identifikationscode der Gemeinde - Akteur - Bezeichnung der Akteursgruppe. Coverage: Land Schleswig-Holstein. The portal files it under the publisher Land Schleswig-Holstein. Its tags are ftth, glasfaser. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
